notYours: This button is for the person who ran the command.
shareFailed: I couldn't post it in this channel.
expired: This button has expired. Run the command again.
failed: I couldn't find {what} right now: the sites that provide them aren't answering. Try again in a moment.
askFirst: Ask your question after the command, like: .8ball Will I win?
rollBad: Write the dice like 2d6, 1d20 or 3d8+2 (up to 100 dice of 1,000 sides).
slappedOnce: {user} has been slapped once on this server.
slapped: {user} has been slapped {n} times on this server.
slapSelf: Slap yourself? Ask a friend instead.
slapBot: Slapping a bot? What did it ever do to you?
img_noKey: {cat} photos come from Unsplash, and this bot has no Unsplash key yet. Try dogs, cats or space.
